sn32.3-12:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn32.3-12:1.3: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sītavalāhakānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn32.3-12:1.4: idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena sucaritaṃ carati vācāya sucaritaṃ carati manasā sucaritaṃ carati
sn32.3-12:1.8: aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sītavalāhakānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyanti.
sn32.3-12:1.9: so annaṃ deti pānaṃ deti vatthaṃ deti yānaṃ deti mālaṃ deti gandhaṃ deti vilepanaṃ deti seyyaṃ deti āvasathaṃ deti
sn32.3-12:1.11: so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sītavalāhakānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
sn32.3-12:1.12: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sītavalāhakānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
